dialogues.speaker: Waranka
dialogues.text: He's every bit as bold as his mother... *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Mama Coco
dialogues.text: Quite the clever kid, that one. Besides, he's still just a kid, so it's not like he can go too far. No need to worry about him too much.

dialogues.speaker: Waranka
dialogues.text: Just thinking about what could happen to him, I...

dialogues.speaker: Mama Coco
dialogues.text: It's fine! No need to scare yourself. Always look on the bright side!

dialogues.speaker: Mama Coco
dialogues.text: I'll help you look for him in a bit. I'm sure he's fine, maybe he's just hanging out with someone else's kids and lost track of time.
